subject: Bridging Team — Suite allocation + overnight rider needs
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Parkside Hotel Sales <sales@parksidehotel.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridging Team — Suite allocation + overnight rider needs

Hi Maria / Parkside events team,

Thanks again for holding our tentative block for the leadership workshop on May 18-20. We're ready to lock details and wanted to share a couple of non-standard requests up front so your team can confirm availability. High-level asks: 

- 6 connecting suites (two 2BR suites + 4 single executive suites) clustered on the same corridor, ideally away from the pool/ballroom.
- Quiet/family floors for a subset of traveling managers (noise sensitivity).
- Two early-arrival VIPs (CEO + head of Product): need check-in at 10:00am on May 18 and pre-programmed keycards for their vehicles, if possible.
- One guest requires accessible roll-in shower.
- Light-touch rider profiles: whiskey preferences, minibar restrictions, pillow firmness, and evening turndown for the C-suite.
- Single masterbill with line items for conformed room nights and incidental guarantee to Redwood Inference (we pay).

Attached is an initial rider sheet to populate (initial_rider_profiles.xlsx). Please confirm whether the six-suite clustering is feasible and send a rooming template (CSV) that we can return with names and arrival windows. Also confirm cutoff for name changes and the options for early check-in fees or complimentary early check-in given our masterbill.

Do you have a preferred point person for keycard pre-programming and for a one-time drop-off of welcome kits on May 18 (we plan ~60 welcome bags)?

Appreciate a quick read — we need to finalize by COB Friday to proceed with contracts.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Event PM, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0199

Attachment: initial_rider_profiles.xlsx (spreadsheet - 24KB)

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@parksidehotel.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: events@parksidehotel.com, Sales Ops <sales@parksidehotel.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging Team — Suite allocation + overnight rider needs

Hi Dylan — great to hear from you, and thanks for the detailed notes. Parkside can accommodate the majority of your requests; here's what I can confirm/ask back: 

- We can hold 6 suites adjacent on the east wing (floors 8-9). We will mark 2 as adjoining 2BR options.
- Quiet-floor preference: we can reserve the 9th floor as "quiet cohort" (no ballroom doors on that corridor).
- Early check-in: complimentary for two VIPs when rooming list and estimated arrival times are provided 72 hours in advance. Otherwise early check-in fee applies.
- Accessibility: we have an accessible suite (unit 904) with roll-in shower; please flag guest name early for rooming.
- Rider notes: we can add guest preferences to the PMS profile; our concierge will hold separate notes for turndown/amenities.
- Masterbill: we can issue a masterbill; draft attached with nightly rates and incidental block guarantee options.

Attached: parkside_block_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal - 160KB), rooming_template.csv (for quick import).

Question: how would you like the rooms to be held for late arrivals (we recommend 24-hour hold for guest with unknown flight times)? Also, is shuttle service needed between the hotel and Redwood's offsite rehearsal space? We can quote both shuttle schedule and on-call sedan service.

If you can return the rooming_template.csv with names, arrival windows, and accessibility/diet flags by Monday (Apr 26), we can finalize the masterbill and pre-program keycards for the VIPs.

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Senior Sales Manager — Parkside Hotel & Conference Center
Attachment: parkside_block_proposal_v2.pdf, rooming_template.csv

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Bridging Team — Suite allocation + overnight rider needs

Forwarding Parkside's proposal — see attached PDF and the CSV template. Quick asks for you both: 

Laura — can you confirm VIP placements? My suggestion: CEO (suite 901, early check-in 10:00), Head of Product (suite 902, early check-in 10:30), and two adjacent execs in 903/904 (note 904 is accessible). If you prefer quieter allocation (move CEO to 906 on same corridor), say so.

Evelyn — please review rider notes: evening turndown + whiskey preferences + two allergy flags (gluten-free breakfasts). Also confirm whether we should add welcome kit note for dietary-safe snacks.

I'm asking Parkside for shuttle quote and their recommendation on 24-hour holds for late arrivals. Please reply with any changes by EOD Monday so I can deliver final CSV to Maria.

Dylan — this looks good. Approve the six-suite cluster on the east wing. Two small changes:

1) Move CEO to 906 as discussed (quieter, same corridor).
2) Please mark suite 904 as "primary accessible" for our guest who needs roll-in shower — we should send that guest's name ASAP.

Evelyn — confirm turndown + gluten-free snacks in welcome kit? Marcus — can you confirm we'll sign masterbill and route invoice to finance (finance@redwood-payables.com)?

Once I have those small confirmations I'll greenlight Dylan to finalize names.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bridging Team — Suite allocation + overnight rider needs

Thanks all — good to proceed. Quick confirmations: 

- Masterbill: Marcus Lin (we will sign). Billing contact for invoicing: payables@redwood-payables.com (external).
- Shuttle: yes, request Parkside quote for two vans (AM runs 7:30-9:30, PM 5:30-7:30).
- Welcome kits: include GF snack option for two identified guests; Evelyn to provide dietary label list by Tuesday morning.

Dylan — we need final rooming_template.csv with names, arrival windows, and the one accessible guest name by EOD Tuesday (Apr 27) so Maria can program keycards. Please attach masterbill_draft.pdf once signed.

-Marcus
Director, Event Ops — Redwood Inference
